name: Inaka de Itazura
source:
You meet a young girl when you move to live in your grandmother's house in the country.
One day when she's tired from playing and falls asleep, you lift up her skirt and
take off her underwear...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE264577.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
当你搬到乡下祖母家居住时，你遇到了一个年轻女孩。
有一天，她玩累了睡着了，你掀起她的裙子，
脱掉她的内衣…

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE264577.html]DLsite English[/url]]
